resultados.refuerzo: La jardinería is gardening, the hobby of looking after plants in the garden.
Un chándal is a tracksuit, the sports outfit worn for running.
El remitente is the sender, whose address goes on the back of an envelope.
El propietario is the owner, the person who legally owns the flat.
Closed is a distractor; the question asks what happened despite the booking.
Una biografía is a biography, a book about a real person's life.
El parlamento is parliament, formed by the Congreso and the Senado together.
Rainfall is a distractor; the question asks what the satellites measure.
Ocean temperature is a distractor; the question asks about the ice left.
Se congela means it freezes: water changes to ice at zero degrees.
Redondo means round, the shape of a ball or a coin.
La gallina is the hen, the farm animal that lays eggs.
Sería is conditional; after si the imperfect subjunctive fuera is needed.
Tendría is conditional; a real condition with si takes the present, tengo.
Habría is conditional; si lo hubiera sabido needs the pluperfect subjunctive, hubiera.
Está is indicative; ojalá about now needs the imperfect subjunctive, estuviera.
Había is indicative; a past wish with ojalá needs hubiera, the pluperfect subjunctive.
Cuidar is infinitive; con tal de que needs a conjugated subjunctive, cuides.
Mejor dicho means or rather; it is used to correct what you have just said.
Insistir is infinitive; por mucho que needs a conjugated subjunctive, insistas.
Y eso que is informal; the formal partner of pero is no obstante.
Aunque is neutral in register; no obstante is the more formal choice here.
Por consiguiente takes the indicative, unlike de ahí que, which takes the subjunctive.
Con lo cual takes the indicative; de ahí que is the one that takes the subjunctive.
Querer is infinitive; no es que needs a conjugated subjunctive, quiera.
Estar is infinitive; siento que needs a conjugated subjunctive, estés.
Hacer is infinitive; dice que reports a fact, so the indicative hace fits.
Parecerse a means to look like, so a is the right preposition.
De is not used here; parecerse takes a before the person you resemble.
Con means with; parecerse takes a, not con.
A Juan lo vi ayer is accepted: lo doubles a person as direct object.
After a conditional, the imperfect subjunctive: le agradecería que me enviara.
Bueno, ya veremos means we will see: a way to avoid a clear yes or no.
After a conditional, the imperfect subjunctive: ¿te importaría que saliera?
After a conditional, the imperfect subjunctive: estaría bien que la llamaras.
Cuenta conmigo accepts: you can count on me, so it is a yes, not a refusal.
Estaría fenomenal is a yes: it would be great, so it accepts the invitation.
Lo mejor sería que takes the imperfect subjunctive, hablaras, not the present hables.
Ayudar is infinitive; deja que needs a conjugated subjunctive, ayude.
Déjame a mí means let me: the way to offer to take over a task.
